title: Signal Brew Launch Video
brief: Create a 10-second launch video for a fictional product called Signal Brew. It should feel precise, optimistic, and cinematic. The product should be visible and the ending frame should feel clean.
successCriteria: The product is visible in the opening or final frame.
The tone feels optimistic and cinematic.
The output avoids dark dystopian visuals.
The final frame is clean enough to use as a thumbnail.
